// Fixture: the one datastore ADR-0052 permits. A session record holds what the BFF minted at the
// OIDC callback — tenant, actor, roles, expiry — and nothing another context owns, so resolving it
// is not the cross-context read invariant 15 forbids. Only legal under internal/session/, and only
// with the marker.
package session

//arch:allow-session-store ADR-0052 — the BFF's own session state, not another context's data
import "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"

func Client(addr string) *redis.Client {
	return redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{Addr: addr})
}
